node.statement: The local fixed-point index depends only on the pointed map germ and is invariant under a coordinate identification: it is computed after restricting to any sufficiently small isolating neighbourhood. The chart kappa identifies the germ of G at p with the germ of T(y)=Ay at 0, and node 1.3.1 shows that 0 is isolated for T. Therefore ind(G,p)=J(T,0)=J(A,0). Combining with the preceding step yields J(A,0)=sgn det(I-A).
